title: Digital Trade Licences and Credentials – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses personal information when you use digital licences and credentials.

internal_links.text: Digital licences and credentials in the Service NSW app

Digital High Risk Work Licence – Terms and Conditions

faqs.q: What types of licences and credentials are covered by this notice?
faqs.a: The notice covers the NSW General Construction Induction Card (White Card), Contractor Licence, Qualified Supervisor Certificate, Tradesperson Certificate, and High Risk Work Licence.

faqs.q: Why does Service NSW collect my personal information?
faqs.a: Information is collected to process your application for a digital licence or credential, or to support your use of it.

Service NSW collects your full name, date of birth, residential address, licence or credential number, and information for verifying your identity, generating, and verifying your digital licence, and recording an activity log.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about privacy?
faqs.a: You can find more information in the Service NSW privacy statement, Privacy collection notices, or the MyServiceNSW Account privacy collection notice.
